text: For the director of music. Of the Sons of Korah. A psalm. Clap your hands, all you nations; shout to God with cries of joy.
the great King over all the earth!
the pride of Jacob, whom he loved. Selah
the Lord amid the sounding of trumpets.
sing praises to our King, sing praises.
sing to him a psalm of praise.
God is seated on his holy throne.
as the people of the God of Abraham, for the kings of the earth belong to God; he is greatly exalted.
